description.value: Duck Creek Farm is a 13-acre family farm on Salt Spring Island that has operated since 1990, growing over 30 varieties of fruits and vegetables using organic, no-till, and non-chemical permaculture practices. The farm sells directly to cyclists and visitors via an on-farm farmstand, a seasonal on-farm Friday market, and the Tuesday market at Centennial Park in town. The property also stewards a salmon enhancement creek, and on any given visit you may encounter eagles, turtles, or beavers alongside the market garden.

address.value: 134 Tripp Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC
